type.description: rows x cols identical LED downlights, edited as ONE light.

width.description: Width (m, plan x) the grid covers.

depth.description: Depth (m, plan y) the grid covers.

lumensEach.description: Lumens of EACH fixture (6 W LED about 450); total = rows x cols x lumensEach.

id.description: Id of the item (items[].id from describe_room or get_scene_summary).

position.description: New plan position [x, y] of the item origin, in metres.

elevation.description: New height of the item bottom above the floor, in metres. Optional.

rotation.description: New rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise seen from above. Optional.

roomId.description: Room the item now belongs to (rooms[].id); null clears it. Optional.

wallId.description: Wall to stand against (walls[].wallId from describe_room).

corner.description: Index of the room polygon vertex (rooms[].polygon order); 0 is the first vertex.

axis.description: Centre on both plan axes, or only on x / y (the other coordinate is then kept).

targetId.description: Entity to face: an item id, an opening id, a wall id or a room id.

side.description: Side of that item, as seen from its front.

name.description: Product name as listed by the provider.

price.description: Shelf price including VAT (TTC) in `currency`, as returned by the server.

dims.description: Assembled outer dimensions in metres, as returned by the server.

snapshotAt.description: When the facts were read from the provider (ISO 8601 date-time).

params.description: Scalar generator parameters; omitted keys use the generator defaults.
